In 2003, I discovered that I had a tumor on my right testicle. The very next day, I had the testicle removed in a very short surgery, and spent the next 10 years recovering. Today I'm cured, healthy and happy.

What questions do you have for me? I'm willing to answer pretty much everything that isn't personally identifiable.
IAMA testicular cancer survivor with four children, AMA!
Were you kids born before or after? How has this changed your sex life?

They were all born before. I am still quite fertile however, with only one testicle. As for libido, it's diminished significantly, but I've coped by exercising more, changing my diet (includes more protein, less carbs) and just generally trying to have sex even when I'm not "horny" to start with. Once I get going, it works just fine.

In a hot bath, I was just fondling my nuts (as guys do because you know, they're there) and noticed that it felt like I had a small rock embedded in the side of my testicle. I thought that was odd, so I showed it to my wife, who said I should go to the doctor TODAY as it could be a tumor. I'm glad she did, because it was a tumor and it was removed the next day.

Wow, that's pretty cool and good on your wife for pointing you to a doctor! Also, congo rats on being cured!

Follow up: do they have any idea on what caused and/or contributed to the growth?

As with pretty much all testicular cancer, no they did not really have any clue what caused it. It generally happens between the ages of 15-35, but there are no specific risk factors that they've been able to point to. Basically, all guys should be checking on a monthly basis, just like girls should check their breasts. Just feel your nuts in a warm shower or bath, and that is generally good enough.

For some reason my project is looking for Microsoft.Owin 2.1.0.0. The version of Microsoft.Owin included with the project is 3.0.1 I've tried Update-Package -Reinstall. In package manager it will only let me select Owin 3.0.1.

I'd be really thankful to anyone who can help me. I'll be here to answer if you need additional information from me. I really want to get this running on my machine but I can't figure out how to build it correctly.
Can anyone please help me with building/compiling voat? I keep getting this error, I feel like I've tried everything.

On lines 85 and 89 in web.config, have you tried making sure the versions match what you have for your local Owin package? Sometimes when updating packages, version references in config files and elsewhere don't get updated.

Edit: just in case version 3+ breaks functionality, you could try grabbing vs 2.1 from here: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.Owin/

Thanks a ton. You were right, my version references were wrong in Web.config.

I updated them by running "Get-Project –All | Add-BindingRedirect" in the package manager and now it works.
